newsitem.title: USA: Lowe's Cos says to open Atlanta superstores.
newsitem.headline: Lowe's Cos says to open Atlanta superstores.

text.p: Lowe's Cos Inc said Wednesday it will open three new superstores in metropolitan Atlanta in late 1997, and may add up to 600 new jobs.
The company said the stores will be called the Lowe's Home Improvement Warehouse, and they will be located in Marietta, Woodstock, and Lilburn.
The company said each store will have more than 150,000 square feet of retail space.
The company did not immedately disclose the amount of money it will invest in the project.
